Spain is facing its most serious migration crisis in years after a mass surge into the North African enclave of Ceuta left at least 72 people dead and reignited debate over European border security. According to Spanish authorities, more than 50,000 people attempted to enter Ceuta from Morocco by land and sea, overwhelming local resources. While the vast majority have since returned to Morocco, Spanish officials continue to recover bodies, reinforce the border, and investigate the role of human smuggling networks and online misinformation in fueling the surge. The crisis has prompted a broader European response. Twenty-two EU member states have called for stronger external border protections, Spain has installed a 500-meter floating sea barrier off Ceuta, and Italy temporarily reinstated border controls with Spain, citing security concerns. Until this incident, Spain had actually experienced a decline in irregular migration during 2026. Through the end of June, 12,138 migrants had entered Spain irregularly; 32% fewer than during the same period in 2025. Arrivals to the Canary Islands were down sharply, while land crossings into Ceuta and Melilla had already increased by more than 150% year-over-year, foreshadowing mounting pressure along Spain's North African land border. 250,000 books. That is how many my Ukrainian publisher, Knygolove knigolove.ua/ lost on 19 July after three Russian Iskander missiles struck the warehouse outside Kyiv. Among them were my books, too. This is war, and war inevitably brings human and material losses. But when books burn, it is not just paper that burns. Culture, memory, and identity burn with them. So does a nation’s right to grow and shape its own future. That is why burning books has always meant far more than destroying merchandise. I have waived my royalties for the next year to help support my publisher. I encourage you to buy Ukrainian books—as a gesture of solidarity with Ukrainians fighting, among other things, for the right to read books in their own language. Books survive as long as there are people to print them and people to read them.

The magnificent world of wild animals ❤️❤️❤️ A moose was slamming into cars, trying to protect what looked like his calf, until people realized he wasn’t guarding his calf at all. In Washington State, traffic came to a stop after drivers saw a moose standing in the road, ramming into the doors of any car that tried to move too close. At first, nobody understood why he was acting so aggressive. Moose can be dangerous, but this one wasn’t just wandering or blocking traffic. He was guarding something. From a distance, some thought it was a moose calf lying in the road. But when people recording zoomed in, they realized it wasn’t a moose calf at all. It was a bear cub. The cub looked like it was asleep or dead in the middle of the road, while the moose stood over it like every passing car was a threat. When wildlife officials arrived, they tried to move the moose back toward the woods, but he refused to leave the cub. Every time they got close, the moose stepped forward like he was ready to fight anything that came near. That’s when officials realized the bear cub wasn’t sleeping. It had been hit by a car and left there. The scene changed instantly. What first looked like a strange wild encounter became something much heavier, because the moose wasn’t confused or angry for no reason. He was standing guard over an injured bear cub, keeping traffic away from the same kind of danger that had already hurt it. Officials were finally able to help the cub and move the moose safely back toward the woods & the people that witnessed it all will never forget that magnificent moose 🫎

Un segundo logro de las colocaciones en moneda local fue que, en un contexto de condiciones financieras más estables, se pudo extender el plazo promedio de la deuda. Y esa extensión de plazos, resalta Quantum, se hizo “a tasas alineadas con la expectativa de inflación y depreciación, mediante una oferta variada de instrumentos”. El tercer aspecto que destaca el informe es que al acumular recursos en pesos para diversos “gastos eventuales, incluyendo la compra de dólares al Banco Central”, el Tesoro logró aumentar los recursos para atender pagos de la deuda y otras obligaciones en esa moneda. 🔗infob.ae/3RLOQCP

El itinerario veraniego incluyó una escala en Jamaica, donde los dos realizaron excursiones naturales y participaron en un encuentro privado con familiares de Bob Marley, según detallaron medios brasileños. Posteriormente, regresaron a Brasil, donde recorrieron el Cristo Redentor en Río y visitaron Sao Goncalo, barrio natal del delantero, en compañía de José Leonardo, hijo menor de Fonseca. LA CIUDAD DE NEUQUÉN APROBÓ UNA ORDENANZA QUE PROHÍBE FUMAR EN LAS PLAZAS Y EN LAS VEREDAS DE LOS COLEGIOS Durante años, la imagen de personas fumando en bares, oficinas públicas, restaurantes o salas de espera fue parte de la vida cotidiana. Sin embargo, la implementación progresiva de leyes antitabaco -desde hace unas dos décadas- modificó profundamente esos hábitos y consolidó una nueva conciencia social sobre los riesgos del humo para la salud. Ahora, la ciudad de Neuquén aprobó una ordenanza que extiende la protección a determinados espacios abiertos frecuentados por familias y menores de edad. La iniciativa fue aprobada por el Concejo Deliberante en junio y establece la creación de espacios libres de humo en plazas, parques temáticos, sectores recreativos de la costa ribereña y veredas de establecimientos educativos. Se trata de una encuesta de la consultora Zentrix según la cual al evaluar la situación personal y la marcha de la economía dos de cada tres argentinos dijeron que sus ingresos se agotan el día 20 del mes. El punto de partida de esa evaluación, según surge del informe de la encuesta, “es un salario que perdió la carrera contra los precios y no la recupera: el 87,4% de los encuestados afirma que su ingreso no le gana a la inflación, un techo que ya no distingue posiciones políticas: el 73% de los votantes oficialistas admite esa pérdida, cifra que entre los opositores trepa al 97,1 por ciento”. Zentrix subraya que la la diferencia entre ambos electorados no está en si el deterioro existe sino en cómo se lo nombra: costo de transición para unos, fracaso económico para otros. “Cuando una experiencia material es tan transversal que alcanza incluso a quienes respaldan al Gobierno deja de ser un problema de gestión para convertirse en una condición de época”, afirma. 🔗infob.ae/4xgz7uP

LA DECISIÓN DEL ASTON VILLA SOBRE EL FUTURO DE DIBU MARTÍNEZ FRENTE AL INTERÉS DE UN GIGANTE DE EUROPA La directiva del Aston Villa recibió en las últimas horas una confirmación clave sobre el futuro de Emiliano Dibu Martínez. Según informó el periodista especializado en fichajes Fabrizio Romano, el club inglés fue notificado por la Juventus acerca de su decisión de no avanzar en las negociaciones por el arquero argentino. La institución italiana consideró que los costos del traspaso resultan excesivos, una postura que fue comunicada formalmente a la dirigencia de Birmingham tras varios días de deliberación interna. La información de La Gazzetta dello Sport aportó detalles sobre las razones detrás de este giro. En el complejo deportivo de Continassa, la Juventus explora alternativas para la portería a poco más de un mes del inicio de la Serie A, mientras cuatro arqueros trabajan bajo la supervisión de Luciano Spalletti y su cuerpo técnico. Ninguno de ellos figura como titular indiscutible para el estreno liguero, un panorama que llevó a la directiva a identificar a Martínez como su “Plan A” para reforzar el arco. Sin embargo, la operación no prosperó por diferencias económicas. La prensa italiana explicó que la Vecchia Signora realizó varios intentos para acercar una propuesta a los directivos del Aston Villa, aunque el club inglés se mantuvo firme en su exigencia de 12 millones de euros por el pase del arquero marplatense. La Juventus evaluó que ese precio está fuera de su alcance y, como consecuencia, optó por descartar la operación. “Juve considera que los costos del traspaso son demasiado altos”, puntualizó Fabrizio Romano en su reporte. 🔗infob.ae/4wD1K5v

DESDE LLA LE PONEN PAÑOS FRÍOS A UNA POSIBLE ALIANZA CON EL PRO: “NI SIQUIERA SABEMOS SI VAMOS A COMPARTIR EL PROYECTO DE CIUDAD” La presidenta del bloque de La Libertad Avanza en la Legislatura de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires, Pilar Ramírez, rechazó adelantar definiciones sobre posibles alianzas políticas en el distrito de cara a las elecciones de 2027 y subrayó que el oficialismo libertario se encuentra abocado a la gestión legislativa y al desarrollo de proyectos para la ciudad. “Lo que nosotros no vamos a hacer es hoy hablar de una alianza cuando todavía falta un montón, porque ni siquiera sabemos si vamos a compartir o no el proyecto de ciudad que nosotros tenemos”, sostuvo Ramírez en una entrevista en el programa Empezando el Día, conducido por Mariana Contartessi en Radio La Red. La diputada remarcó que “este es un año de gestión y falta muchísimo para el año que viene. Y el año que viene discutiremos cómo son las candidaturas”. Consultada sobre una posible candidatura de Patricia Bullrich en la Ciudad y la chance de acompañarla, Ramírez valoró la trayectoria de Bullrich y afirmó que “cualquier afiliado a la Libertad Avanza está en condiciones de ser candidato”, aunque reiteró que “falta muchísimo para esas definiciones”. 🔗infob.ae/4yTUILc

The U.S. State Department renewed its warning yesterday for Americans across the Middle East, urging heightened vigilance amid the increasingly volatile regional security environment. Americans currently in the region are advised to consider departing while commercial travel remains available or be prepared to leave if the situation deteriorates. The advisory warns of potential flight cancellations, periodic airspace closures, and other travel disruptions. Americans outside the region are urged to reconsider travel to or through the Middle East. The updated warning follows a series of increasingly specific security alerts issued in recent weeks, including notices for Jordan, Bahrain, and, for the first time, Egypt, reflecting the geographic expansion of Iranian attacks and concerns that Iran or Iran-backed groups could target U.S. diplomatic facilities, businesses, and other American interests both within and beyond the Middle East.

Ukraine's long-range drone campaign appears to have struck another Wildberries distribution center, this time in Novosyomyeikino, continuing a sustained effort to target Russia's largest e-commerce and logistics network. According to Russian officials, the strike ignited a fire at the facility. This video from Telegram purportedly shows a massive fire at the facility following the earlier Ukrainian drone strike. Wildberries is essentially Russia's equivalent of Amazon, operating the country's largest online marketplace with an extensive nationwide warehousing and distribution network. Ukraine argues the company supports Russia's war effort by selling dual-use goods and equipment used by the military, an allegation Moscow denies. The attack is the latest in a broader campaign that has targeted roughly a dozen Wildberries facilities since mid-July, disrupting an estimated 10% of the company's logistics capacity and forcing the retailer to reroute shipments, compensate victims, and absorb significant financial losses. The strikes reflect Ukraine's increasing focus on economic and logistics infrastructure well beyond the front lines, aiming to raise the cost of sustaining Russia's war effort while disrupting everyday commerce. The U.S. Air Force KC-135 "Stratotanker" that survived the fatal midair collision with another KC-135 over Iraq in March is now en route towards the United Kingdom, likely beginning its return to the United States. Based on the extensive structural damage sustained in the collision, it is likely the aircraft was repaired using a replacement tail section sourced from a retired KC-135 at the 309th Aerospace Maintenance and Regeneration Group, aka the "Boneyard", at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base in Tucson, Arizona. While the U.S. Air Force has not publicly detailed the repair, such component replacements are a well established practice for returning heavily damaged aircraft to service.

Сьогодні Повітряні Сили – це значно більше ніж один із видів військ. Це складова нашого захисту, яка багато в чому реально визначає перебіг цієї війни. Українці не віддали і не віддають росіянам своє небо. І один з найбільш вагомих результатів нашого народу за час повномасштабної війни. Ми не дали знищити наші Повітряні Сили та змогли розвинути їх так, що Росія регулярно втрачає свої літаки. І зараз, коли єдиною ставкою, останньою ставкою, яка залишилась у Путіна, є його масовані удари проти України, Повітряні Сили – наша бойова авіація знищує російські крилаті ракети, старається знищити балістику, і, коли дивізіони наших «петріотів» не пусті, це вдається. Важливо, що завдяки нашій співпраці з Європою наші «айріси», «хоки», «насамси» працюють. Ми кожен день боремось за постачання ракет до них. І я вдячний, що партнери в світі нам із цим допомагають. Звісно, що балістика залишається проблемою, але ми забезпечили Україні захист від значної кількості крилатих ракет і збиваємо суттєво. Рівень збиття ударних дронів теж більше 90%, і це дуже вагомий результат України – усіх нас, усіх вас. Я дякую всім вам – усім присутнім тут, кожному й кожній з оборонців українського неба, які попри фактично нерівний бій та недостатність засобів для збиття роблять неймовірні речі – роблять більше ніж максимум. Ви показали світу майстерність і довели: українці спроможні долати будь-що і потрібні для цього лише зброя і засоби. Пишаємося вами. І шануємо всіх наших героїв, хто віддав своє життя, аби жила Україна, хто захистив нас і назавжди залишився в небі.

Today, the Air Force is much more than just one branch of the military. It is a component of our defense that, in many ways, truly shapes the course of this war. Ukrainians did not surrender – and will not surrender – their skies to Russia. That is one of our nation's greatest achievements throughout this full-scale war. We did not allow our Air Force to be destroyed, and have built it up to the point where Russia regularly loses its aircraft. And now, when the only thing – the last thing – Putin has left to bet on is his massive attacks against Ukraine, the Air Force, our combat aviation, is destroying Russian cruise missiles and trying to destroy ballistic missiles as well. And when our Patriot batteries aren't empty, it succeeds. It is important that, thanks to our cooperation with Europe, our IRIS-T, Hawk, and NASAMS systems are operating. Every day, we fight to secure missile supplies for them. And I am grateful that our partners around the world are helping us with that. Of course, ballistic missiles remain a challenge. But we have provided Ukraine with protection against a significant share of cruise missiles, and we are shooting down a great many. Our interception rate against attack drones is also above 90%, and that is a truly significant achievement for Ukraine – for all of us, for every one of you. I thank all of you – all those gathered here today, every man and woman defending Ukraine's skies – who, despite fighting what is, in reality, an unequal battle and lacking sufficient means to bring down enemy targets, accomplish the incredible, go beyond the maximum. You have shown the world your skill and proven that Ukrainians are capable of overcoming anything. All we need are the weapons and the means to do it. We are proud of you. And we honor all our heroes who gave their lives so that Ukraine lives – those who protected us and remain in the skies forever. Video

EL ACALORADO CRUCE ENTRE RODRIGO DE PAUL Y UNA FIGURA DE CABO VERDE EN EL EMPATE DEL INTER MIAMI POR LA MLS El fútbol no olvida, y menos cuando se vieron las caras previamente en una cita mundial. Apenas semanas después de haber disputado uno de los partidos más emocionantes en la historia moderna de los Mundiales, Rodrigo De Paul y el defensor franco-caboverdiano Steven Moreira se volvieron a ver las caras. Esta vez, el escenario no fue la eliminación directa de una Copa del Mundo, sino la fase regular de la Major League Soccer (MLS). Sin embargo, la intensidad sobre el césped demostró que la tensión nacida en Miami sigue completamente intacta. El reencuentro se dio en el marco del vibrante empate 2-2 entre el Inter Miami CF y el Columbus Crew, donde ambos futbolistas volvieron a sacarse chispas. Los videos que inundaron las redes sociales expusieron cruces verbales de alta tensión, discusiones cara a cara y un juego físico al límite que recordó de inmediato por qué estos dos atletas están en la elite de sus respectivas posiciones. El partido tuvo de todo: desde faltas tácticas de De Paul hasta un golazo de Luis Suárez desde más de 30 metros, pero el foco de atención se lo llevó la batalla personal entre el argentino y el defensor africano. 🔗infob.ae/3RO8QEV

EL ÁRTICO EN ALERTA: CÓMO SON LAS EXPEDICIONES QUE INVESTIGAN LA REGIÓN MÁS AFECTADA POR EL CALENTAMIENTO GLOBAL | Por Camila Caruso El Ártico, inhóspito y aparentemente lejano, revela señales de alarma que resuenan en todo el planeta. Mientras otras regiones observan cómo las temperaturas suben gradualmente, en estas latitudes extremas los cambios avanzan a un ritmo sin precedentes. El hielo que alguna vez cubría mares y costas durante todo el año retrocede y se fragmenta, lo que abre rutas antes imposibles y altera el equilibrio de océanos y atmósfera. Para entender lo que está ocurriendo, equipos internacionales pusieron en marcha expediciones que desafían el frío, la oscuridad y la distancia. Sus descubrimientos no solo buscan explicar por qué el Ártico se calienta más rápido que cualquier otro lugar, sino también anticipar las consecuencias de este fenómeno para la vida en la Tierra. La exploración de bases flotantes y misiones a bordo de rompehielos permite observar de cerca los detalles de un territorio donde el futuro del clima global se decide cada día. 🔗infob.ae/4qc2w7f

On the night of 26 March 1958, a 28-year-old actress from Georgia stood up at the Academy Awards and collected the Oscar for Best Actress. She was wearing an emerald-green gown that she had designed and stitched herself, over two weeks, out of about a hundred dollars' worth of fabric. Hollywood's old guard was not impressed. Joan Crawford, the reigning authority on glamour, declared that by making her own clothes, this young woman was setting the cause of Hollywood glamour back twenty years. Her name was Joanne Woodward. And she never apologised for that dress. Years later, when a museum in her home state asked if they could display it, she turned them down. She'd worked on it for two weeks, she said. She was almost as proud of that dress as she was of the Oscar. She was born Joanne Gignilliat Trimmier Woodward on 27 February 1930 in Thomasville, Georgia, and grew up between there, Greenville in South Carolina, and Marietta. And there's a story from her childhood that tells you everything about the kind of person she was going to be. In 1939, when she was nine years old, the premiere of Gone with the Wind was held in Atlanta, with a parade of the biggest film stars in the world moving through the streets. Joanne did not stand on the pavement and wave. She got into the parade. She ended up sitting on Laurence Olivier's lap. She entered beauty pageants as a teenager, studied drama at Louisiana State University, and then did what ambitious young actors did in that era: she went to New York and got serious. She trained at the Neighborhood Playhouse. She got into the Actors Studio. She worked constantly in the live television anthology dramas of the early 1950s, the proving ground for a whole generation of American actors. Then, in 1953, she took a job as an understudy in a Broadway production of William Inge's play Picnic. Another understudy on that production was a young actor named Paul Newman. He was married, with three children. What followed was not tidy, and neither of them ever pretended otherwise. They fell for each other. His first marriage ended. Woodward, who had at one point been engaged to the writer Gore Vidal, broke that off. Paul Newman and Joanne Woodward married in Las Vegas on 29 January 1958. Less than two months later, she won the Oscar. The film was The Three Faces of Eve, and the role was extraordinary — a Georgia housewife living with what was then called multiple personality disorder. Woodward had to play three entirely separate people inside one woman: Eve White, the timid wife; Eve Black, the reckless one; and Jane, the third. She gave each of them their own voice, posture and physical rhythm, and she moved between them in single unbroken shots. It was only her third feature film. And here is the part that made her career unusual for its time. She could have become a manufactured Hollywood glamour product, and she flatly refused to. She spent the next four decades choosing complicated, difficult, unglamorous women. Frustrated housewives. Lonely schoolteachers. Women in crisis. Roles that many of her contemporaries were steered away from because they weren't flattering. Her husband directed her in several of them, most famously Rachel, Rachel in 1968, in which she played a repressed small-town spinster — a performance that won her a Golden Globe and is still regarded as some of the finest work either of them ever did. They made more than a dozen films together. They also, quietly and stubbornly, refused to behave like movie stars. They raised their three daughters in Connecticut rather than Los Angeles. She ran the Westport Country Playhouse as its artistic director. In 1990, at the age of 60, Joanne Woodward collected a bachelor's degree from Sarah Lawrence College — walking at the same graduation ceremony as her own youngest daughter. And in 1985, she took a television role that, in hindsight, is almost unbearable to think about. The film was called Do You Remember Love. She played a university professor — a poet, a woman who lived by language and by her mind — who is diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease, and slowly loses the ability to hold on to her own words. She won an Emmy for it. It's widely considered one of the finest performances of her career. Twenty-two years later, in 2007, Joanne Woodward was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease herself. She was 77. The following year, Paul Newman died of cancer, ending a marriage that had lasted fifty years — a genuine rarity in that industry, and something both of them had worked at rather than simply been lucky with. Woodward's last film appearance had been in Philadelphia in 1993, where she played Tom Hanks's mother. Her final screen work came in 2005, opposite Newman, in the miniseries Empire Falls. Her last public appearance was in 2013. Then she stepped out of public life entirely, and her family closed the door behind her. For years, almost nobody outside that circle knew. Then, in 2022, the actor and director Ethan Hawke made a six-part documentary series about the two of them called The Last Movie Stars. He had been asked to do it by the couple's eldest daughter, Nell. And during the promotion, Hawke explained why the family had wanted it made at that specific moment, rather than later. They wanted it finished while she was still alive to see it. They wanted her to be able to watch it, and to feel supported by it. By then, he said, she was nearly fifteen years into the illness. Joanne Woodward turned 96 in February 2026. She is one of the last surviving stars of that entire era of Hollywood — the world of studio contracts and live television and premieres with searchlights, most of which now exists only on film. She played a woman whose mind held three separate people, and made every one of them real. She played a woman losing her memory, decades before it came for her own. And she showed up to the biggest night of her life in a dress she'd made herself on a sewing machine, and let the most glamorous woman in Hollywood say whatever she liked about it. She was almost as proud of that dress as she was of the Oscar. She said so, and she meant it, and she never gave it away.

【買取業務に関するご報告とお詫び】 本日、当店にて買取をご利用いただいたお客様より、「提出したカードが足りない」とのご指摘をいただきました。お客様は7枚提出されたとお申し出いただきましたが、当店側では当時5枚しか確認できず、査定担当者も「そのカードは見ていない」と回答いたしました。 その後、受付担当が防犯カメラの映像確認を提案し、査定担当者が該当の映像を確認。映っていた場面を写真で撮影し、お客様に提示いたしましたが、その映像には5枚しか映っていないように見えました。 その時点で受付担当は「映像で5枚しか確認できないため、納得いただけない場合は警察を呼んでご確認いただいた方が良いのでは」とお伝えしました。この発言はお客様への不信を前提としたものではありませんでしたが、結果として高圧的に受け取られかねないものであり、深く反省しております。 一度はお客様より「納得した」とのお言葉をいただきましたが、その数時間後「やはり足りないので再確認してほしい」とのご連絡をいただきました。PSAの鑑定番号も添えていただき、改めてより広い範囲の映像を確認したところ、お客様が査定物を出す準備の段階において、確かに7枚のカードをお出しになっていたことが確認されました。 結果として、査定担当者が7枚中5枚のみを査定し、残りの2枚を誤って査定済み用のケースに収納していたことが原因であったことが判明しました。このミスにより、お客様に不信感とご迷惑をおかけしてしまったことを、深くお詫び申し上げます。 今回の件では以下のような点が、お客様の信頼を損なう結果につながってしまいました： ①防犯映像が5枚に見えたという理由のみで、お客様のご申告を否定してしまったこと （映像には角度や映り方による限界があり、確定的な判断材料とすべきではありませんでした） ②「警察を呼びますか」といった対応が、誠実さではなく威圧と受け取られるような表現になってしまったこと ③映像確認の範囲が不十分で、カード提出の準備段階を確認していなかったこと （結果として「十分に確認もしていないのに、否定された」と感じさせてしまった可能性があります） お客様の大切なお品物をお預かりする立場として、あるまじき対応だったと真摯に受け止めております。 今後は以下のような再発防止策を徹底し、同様のことが起こらぬよう努めてまいります。 ・査定時のカード枚数を受付・査定・返却の各段階で必ず記録・照合 ・映像確認は受付〜準備段階〜査定開始までを通して行うことを明文化 このたびは、お客様に多大なご不快とご心配をおかけし、誠に申し訳ございませんでした。 今後とも誠実な対応と改善に努めてまいります。

DOS JÓVENES ROBARON UNA FERRETERÍA, LE DISPARARON EN EL PECHO AL DUEÑO Y HUYERON TRAS ASESINARLO Un violento asalto finalizó con la muerte de un comerciante local en el barrio Malvinas Argentinas, en la ciudad de Mar del Plata. El hecho tuvo lugar el sábado al mediodía en la intersección de Avenida Libertad y Luciano Arrué, cuando dos personas armadas ingresaron a una ferretería y dispararon contra el dueño. El ataque desencadenó un operativo policial que resultó en la detención de los sospechosos y el secuestro del arma utilizada. La víctima fue identificada como Ricardo Ruiz, quien se encontraba trabajando cuando los asaltantes irrumpieron en su local. Tras intimidarlo, uno de ellos le disparó en el pecho antes de huir a pie, abandonando la motocicleta en la que habían llegado. Los vecinos, alertados por los ruidos, acudieron y hallaron al comerciante gravemente herido. “Estaba muy mal, se estaba muriendo”, relató uno de los testigos al medio 0223. Tras el ataque, Ruiz fue trasladado en un patrullero al Hospital Interzonal General de Agudos (Higa), donde ingresó con signos vitales y recibió atención médica de urgencia. Los profesionales intentaron estabilizarlo, pero la herida resultó fatal y el comerciante falleció minutos después de su ingreso. La noticia de su muerte generó conmoción y tristeza en la comunidad, que lo reconocía como un referente barrial. 🔗infob.ae/4w0QvCM

LA OPEP+ AUMENTARÁ LA PRODUCCIÓN DE PETRÓLEO EN 188.000 BARRILES DIARIOS DESDE SEPTIEMBRE La alianza de países petroleros conocida como OPEP+ acordó este domingo un aumento de la producción de petróleo en 188.000 barriles diarios a partir de septiembre. La decisión, adoptada tras una reunión virtual entre Arabia Saudita, Rusia y cinco países adicionales del grupo, se produce mientras persisten las interrupciones en el flujo de crudo a causa de la guerra en Medio Oriente. El ajuste fue confirmado mediante un comunicado conjunto de los siete integrantes participantes: “Los siete países participantes decidieron implementar un ajuste de producción de 188 mil barriles por día”. Analistas habían previsto este incremento, que representa la culminación de la segunda fase de desmantelamiento de los recortes voluntarios implementados por la OPEP+ durante el periodo de caída de precios entre 2022 y 2023. 🔗infob.ae/4xhsMiI

I have stood firmly with the students and their movement from the very beginning. Their fight is not just for justice in the NEET scam- It is a fight to protect the future of every young Indian. The brutal crackdown by the Delhi Police on peaceful protesters is deeply disturbing and utterly unacceptable. Students were mercilessly beaten, lathi-charged, fired upon with pellet guns and subjected to tear gas simply for demanding accountability. So fearful is the Union Government of a peaceful democratic movement that it reportedly suspended internet services in and around Jantar Mantar and invoked the draconian National Security Act (NSA) to carry out preventive detentions of students- The very future of our nation. The Prime Minister speaks of zero tolerance towards corruption and promises strict accountability. Yet, only yesterday, the CBI stated that it found no evidence against the alleged kingpin in the 2024 NEET paper leak case. If those accused of destroying the future of lakhs of students continue to escape accountability, who is the government really protecting? Why is it so desperate to shield the Education Minister instead of answering the questions being raised by students across the country? The entire Opposition, along with the entire nation, stands firmly with our students and youth. I salute every young Indian for their indomitable spirit, unwavering courage, and refusal to bow before lathis, intimidation or the abuse of state power. India is proud of you all.

LA CREACIÓN DE EMPRESAS EN ARGENTINA ESTÁ EN NIVELES MÍNIMOS DESDE 2002 | Por Matías Barbería En Argentina, la creación de empresas alcanzó su punto más bajo desde la crisis de 2002, según informes de consultoras privadas y organismos oficiales. La dinámica de generación de firmas nuevas evidencia una debilidad estructural que se refleja tanto en la estadística como en los testimonios de los analistas del mercado laboral y productivo. Según el último reporte de CP Consultora, la cantidad de empresas nuevas es comparable a la de los años más duros de la crisis macroeconómica de comienzos de siglo. “La creación de empresas está en niveles similares a los de 2002. Esto refleja una dinámica complicada, mucho más difícil que la evidenciada en períodos de cambio estructural”, resalta el informe. El documento agrega que el fenómeno no implica únicamente menos firmas activas, sino también una retracción en la dotación de personal y un aumento en el cierre de compañías. “La tasa de apertura de nuevas empresas está en los niveles de la crisis de 2001-2002, coherente con una economía anémica y sin un horizonte claro, aun para el mundo empresario”, describe la consultora. 🔗infob.ae/4wDkbqI

'एआय सेंटर ऑफ कॉम्पिटन्सी'चे उदघाटन करण्यात आले. शैक्षणिक संस्थांनी आता नोकऱ्यांच्या क्षेत्रातील गरजा लक्षात घेऊन रोजगारक्षम, अत्याधुनिक कौशल्यांनी सज्ज, कालसुसंगत मनुष्यबळ घडविण्यावर भर दिला पाहिजे. आजच्या नोकऱ्यांच्या क्षेत्राला केवळ पदवीधरांची गरज नाही, तर अर्थपूर्ण योगदान देणाऱ्या गुणवत्तापूर्ण मनुष्यबळाची गरज आहे, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, देशातील एक अग्रणी शैक्षणिक संस्था म्हणून रामदेवबाबा विद्यापीठाने आपले वेगळे स्थान निर्माण केले आहे. शिक्षणाच्या मूळ उद्देशांशी स्वतःला जोडून ठेवत व्यापारीकरणापासून दूर राहण्याचे कार्य या संस्थेने केले आहे. खासगी संस्था असूनही देशातील अग्रगण्य शैक्षणिक संस्थांमध्ये तिचा समावेश होतो. आज या संस्थेचे विद्यापीठात रुपांतर झाले आहे. संशोधनाच्या क्षेत्रात तसेच शिक्षणाला नवा आकार देणाऱ्या देशातील अत्यंत नामांकित विद्यापीठांमध्ये या विद्यापीठाचा समावेश होईल. कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता, सेमिकॉन आणि क्वांटम कम्प्युटिंग तंत्रज्ञान हे या शतकाच्या भविष्याला आकार देणारे प्रमुख घटक ठरणार आहेत. ज्या प्रचंड वेगाने तंत्रज्ञान तसेच व्यवसायाचे स्वरूप बदलत आहे, ते लक्षात घेता आपल्या शैक्षणिक संस्थांनी नव्या तंत्रज्ञानाचा अंगीकार करणे आवश्यक आहे. क्वांटम कम्प्युटिंगमुळे संशोधन प्रक्रियेला अभूतपूर्व गती मिळाली आहे. बायोटेक्नॉलॉजी, रोबोटिक्स असो किंवा इतर कोणतेही क्षेत्र असो, तंत्रज्ञानातील प्रगतीमुळे जीवनाच्या प्रत्येक क्षेत्रात परिवर्तन घडत आहे. कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्तेमुळे येत्या 1000 दिवसांत नोकऱ्यांच्या Además, se busca consolidarlo con la reforma de la Carta Orgánica del Banco Central de la República Argentina para que nunca más se puedan emitir pesos para financiar al Tesoro y recibir a cambio Letras Intransferibles. Sin embargo, para muchos analistas existe una asignatura pendiente: encender todos los motores de la actividad productiva y comercial. Inicialmente lo hicieron el agro pampeano y regional, el sector energético y la nueva minería, mientras se mantienen frenados y en retroceso gran parte de la industria manufacturera, el comercio interior y los servicios vinculados con el mercado interno. Con ese cuadro, Infobae entrevistó a Lucas Pussetto, con máster en economía y empresa por la Universidad Pompeu Fabra de Barcelona, profesor en el EMBA y en programas ejecutivos de la Escuela de Negocios de la Universidad Austral, además de asesorar a empresas en Argentina y la región, para analizar la coyuntura y compartir sus expectativas para lo que resta del año. 🔗infob.ae/3RuCRK2

𝗚𝗶𝗿𝗹𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗼𝘂𝘁-𝗲𝗻𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗺𝗲𝗻 𝗶𝗻 𝗵𝗶𝗴𝗵𝗲𝗿 𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗮𝗰𝗿𝗼𝘀𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗮 According to AISHE 2023–24: •The national Gender Parity Index (GPI) reached a record 1.08, up from the previous high of 1.06 in 2019–20. •The Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER) for women increased to 31.2%, compared with 28.9% for men. •Women's enrolment now exceeds men's in all but three states. The pandemic briefly pulled the GPI down to 1.01, but women's enrolment continued to rise throughout. Men's enrolment simply grew faster for two years before women widened their lead again, taking the index to its highest level in 2023–24. The state-level picture is equally encouraging. Even among the seven states where the GPI declined, six recorded higher enrolment for women—the index fell only because men's enrolment increased faster. Manipur was the only exception, with enrolment declining for both women and men. The Gender Parity Index is most useful when read alongside enrolment rates. It shows that higher education is expanding across India, with women benefiting the most, while also highlighting the states where women's access still lags or where changes in parity require closer interpretation, such as Bihar. The real challenge now lies beyond the classroom. India has made remarkable progress in educating women. The next policy imperative is ensuring these educational gains translate into higher female labour force participation, better-quality jobs, and stronger representation in the workforce. #GenderParity #WomenInEducation #FemaleLabourForceParticipation #EducationToEmployment #India #GenderData #WomenEmpowerment

Can artificial intelligence help us better understand and protect water resources? The IAEA is exploring this through a Coordinated Research Project that combines AI and isotope hydrology to improve water resource management. By integrating isotope data with machine learning, satellite observations, and environmental monitoring, scientists can gain deeper insights into groundwater systems, identify emerging trends, and support evidence-based decisions for sustainable water management. As growing water demand puts increasing pressure on freshwater resources, innovative tools like AI can help improve how we monitor and manage this vital resource. 🔗 Read more: atoms.iaea.org/4wTieGe

Saudi Arabia's message to Washington is becoming increasingly clear. It echoes the warning delivered by Defense Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman during his visit to Washington last week: if the United States launches major strikes against Iran's energy infrastructure, Saudi Arabia and the Gulf states will likely bear the immediate consequences. Tehran has already signaled what it would target across the Gulf if President Trump follows through on his threats. From Riyadh's perspective, the timing could hardly be worse. With tensions rising again with the Houthis, the last thing Saudi Arabia wants is a broader regional confrontation with Iran. This also highlights a broader strategic reality. The war has strengthened Iran's deterrence vis-à-vis the Gulf states. For Gulf leaders, preserving regional stability has become a higher priority than pursuing a decisive confrontation with Tehran. At the same time, the core dispute remains unresolved. There is still no agreement over the future of the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran shows no indication that it is willing to compromise on what it views as its role there. As long as that issue remains unsettled, there is no obvious diplomatic off-ramp. So far, Iran's strategy of increasing pressure on the Gulf state, treating them as the weakest link in Washington's regional coalitio, appears to be producing results. The focus is shifting back to quiet diplomacy between Oman and Iran, as both sides explore whether a compromise over the Strait of Hormuz is still possible. But regardless of what emerges from those talks, the key decision will once again rest with Washington. If an agreement is reached, will the Trump administration be prepared to accept it? If not, will it ultimately decide that military escalation is the only remaining option? President Trump's hesitation also suggests that the administration itself is far from convinced that a broader military campaign would weaken Iran or compel it to concede. That uncertainty helps explain why, despite repeated threats, diplomacy continues to be the preferred path. In stark contrast to what Deng did in China, up to a million North Koreans starved to death in the 1990s because their government had already banned private farming and lived off Soviet handouts. The Soviet collapse in 1991 cut the free fuel and fertilizer that had kept the whole system afloat for decades, and energy imports dropped 75% almost overnight. North Korea had fully collectivized its farms since the 1950s, so farmers held almost no private plots and had zero reason to grow more than the state’s quota. When the free inputs vanished the system had no slack left. Floods in 1995 finished off what crops remained, and the Public Distribution System that nearly the entire population relied on for food simply collapsed in large parts of the country. City rations fell from 585 grams of grain a day in 1987 to 30 grams by 1997. The regime called it the “Arduous March”. And even after Kim Il Sung died the year the famine began, his son kept the exact same centrally planned system running for the next 17 years while hundreds of thousands starved. And that is the body count of full collectivization under communism. Video Rothmus 🏴 (@Rothmus) 800 million people were lifted out of extreme poverty in China thanks to a little bit of capitalism. Central planning doesn’t work. At least Deng Xiaoping saw Mao’s catastrophic blunders and understood that. Which is why when he took power, he ripped out the collectivized economy by the roots. >let farmers work their own plots and sell what they grew instead of farming for the state (food production soared almost overnight) >carved out Special Economic Zones like Shenzhen where foreign capital could operate under different rules than the rest of communist China > poverty crashed from nearly 90% in 1981 to under 4% by 2016 On his Southern Tour in 1992, Deng told CCP officials “to get rich is glorious.” He was right btw. Al-Hidayah Canada 2026 Opens with Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri’s Landmark Lecture on Humanity, Morality and Spiritual Revival Hamilton, Ontario (Canada): The inaugural al-Hidayah Canada 2026, the first-ever three-day residential, spiritual and educational camp of its kind in North America, at McMaster University. The event commenced with a profound keynote address by His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri upon the theme "From Humanity to Depravity: A Moral and Spiritual Descent”. Shaykh-ul-Islam presented a comprehensive Qur'anic framework explaining the nature of the human soul, the causes of moral decline, and the path towards spiritual purification and human excellence. Opening his address, Shaykh-ul-Islam expressed heartfelt gratitude to Allah the Almighty for granting the opportunity to establish al-Hidayah in North America. He described the occasion as a historic milestone for Minhaj-ul-Quran International, expressing hope that the initiative would become a lasting institution for nurturing the spiritual and intellectual development of Muslim youth across the continent. He congratulated the leadership and volunteers of Minhaj-ul-Quran International Canada, Muslim Youth League, Minhaj Women League, Minhaj Welfare Foundation, Minhaj Sisters, and the entire organising team for their months of tireless dedication in making the event possible. He noted that many of the organisers had previously attended al-Hidayah camps in the United Kingdom and, inspired by their experience, resolved to establish a similar platform in Canada. Shaykh-ul-Islam prayed that this initiative would continue to flourish and eventually expand across North America, including the United States. A particularly significant aspect of the event, he observed, was the remarkable participation of women. Congratulating Minhaj Women League and Minhaj Sisters, he highlighted the equal representation of men and women throughout the camp. Reflecting on nearly five decades of his mission, he stated that he had never witnessed women lagging behind men in commitment, service or organisational excellence. Rather, he noted, they had consistently stood shoulder to shoulder with men, and in many cases surpassed them in dedication and performance. He prayed that Almighty Allah accept the efforts of every volunteer and reward them abundantly in this world and the Hereafter. Introducing the central theme of his lecture series, Shaykh-ul-Islam explained that "From Humanity to Depravity: A Moral and Spiritual Descent" is a subject he was presenting publicly for the first time in this systematic order and structure. Spread across three keynote sessions, the series explores how human beings gradually descend from the lofty station of humanity towards moral and spiritual corruption, identifies the signs of this decline, and presents the Qur'anic methodology for restoring human dignity and spiritual excellence. The Dual Nature of Human Beings Drawing upon the Holy Qur'an, Shaykh-ul-Islam explained that Allah Almighty has created human beings with both physical and spiritual dimensions, placing within every person two opposing capacities: the ability to ascend towards righteousness and the possibility of descending into corruption. He explained that every individual possesses the potential to cultivate angelic qualities such as compassion, purity, truthfulness and obedience to Allah. At the same time, human beings also possess a lower self (nafs) that can become dominated by uncontrolled desires, animalistic instincts and satanic inclinations if left undisciplined. According to Shaykh-ul-Islam, true human dignity lies not in suppressing natural instincts altogether but in bringing them under the discipline of divine revelation, moral consciousness, intellect and spiritual awareness. Human excellence is achieved when desires remain within the boundaries established by Allah. The Qur'anic Principle of Free Choice Quoting verses 8–10 of Surah al-Balad, Shaykh-ul-Islam explained that Allah has granted every person eyes, a tongue, lips, intellect and moral awareness, and has clearly shown humanity two distinct paths—the path of goodness and the path of evil. He elaborated that the Qur'anic expression "An-Najdayn" signifies two elevated, clearly visible and unmistakable paths. Human beings are never left confused regarding truth and falsehood. Allah has made both routes evident, while granting every individual the freedom to choose between them through reason, conscience and free will. He emphasised that moral character is shaped by personal choices, upbringing, environment, companionship and continuous self-training. The direction a person ultimately follows depends upon the decisions they repeatedly make throughout life. Guidance Requires Purification Referring to Surah al-Fatihah, Shaykh-ul-Islam explained that the Qur'an presents guidance as a comprehensive process consisting of both spiritual growth and purification. He noted that following the path of the righteous alone is insufficient unless one simultaneously distances oneself from the paths that incur Allah's displeasure and those that lead people astray. Spiritual progress therefore requires not only adopting righteous influences but also actively removing the negative influences, sinful tendencies and destructive habits that corrupt the soul. Quoting the Qur'anic declaration, "Successful indeed is the one who purifies the soul, and unsuccessful is the one who corrupts it," he emphasised that genuine spiritual success cannot be achieved without sustained self-purification (tazkiyah). Moral Decline is a Gradual Process A central focus of the lecture was Shaykh-ul-Islam's explanation that moral collapse never occurs suddenly but unfolds gradually. He described the process beginning when a person repeatedly ignores the voice of conscience. Over time, desires replace divine guidance, sinful actions become habitual, excuses are created to justify wrongdoing, and sensitivity towards goodness steadily weakens. Eventually, repeated choices reshape human personality itself. According to Shaykh-ul-Islam, human beings ultimately become what they consistently choose, practise and nurture within themselves. Human personality is therefore dynamic rather than fixed, continuously shaped by decisions, environment, companionship, education and moral discipline. From Humanity to Animality and Depravity Explaining the title of the lecture, Shaykh-ul-Islam distinguished between humanity, animality and depravity. He stated that a person descends into animality when instincts begin governing life and higher moral faculties are neglected. This stage is marked by increasing domination of desires over reason and spirituality. An even more dangerous stage is depravity, where intelligence itself begins serving evil desires. At this level, individuals not only commit wrongdoing but intellectually justify it, defend it, promote it and legitimise immoral behaviour. Drawing upon the Qur'anic account of the creation of Prophet Adam (peace be upon him), Shaykh-ul-Islam explained that humanity possesses both earthly and spiritual dimensions. While the physical body is connected to material needs and worldly instincts, the divine spirit enables human beings to attain moral excellence, spiritual awareness and closeness to Allah. The lifelong struggle lies in ensuring that the spiritual dimension governs the material one. Created in the Best Form—but Responsible for Maintaining It Reflecting on Surah at-Tin, Shaykh-ul-Islam explained the Qur'anic declaration: "Indeed, We created man in the best of forms; then We reduced him to the lowest of the low—except those who believe and perform righteous deeds." He explained that being created in "Ahsan Taqweem" refers not merely to physical beauty but to the complete balance of human intellectual, moral, spiritual and physical capacities. However, he stressed that this excellence is only the starting point, not a permanent guarantee. Using the analogy of a newly manufactured vehicle, he explained that while the Creator fashions humanity in perfection, maintaining that state depends upon human responsibility, discipline and obedience. Neglect, moral accidents and spiritual corruption are consequences of one's own choices rather than defects in the Creator's design. Ghaflah: The Beginning of Spiritual Decline Towards the conclusion of the first session, Shaykh-ul-Islam identified ghaflah (heedlessness of Allah) as the first stage of moral and spiritual decline. He explained that when heedlessness enters the heart, truth, sincerity, accountability, modesty, generosity and moral responsibility gradually cease to guide human behaviour. Instead, life becomes dominated by bodily pleasure, selfish interests, worldly ambitions and unchecked desires. Unless this decline is halted through repentance, self-accountability, moral discipline and spiritual training, it progresses from heedlessness to animalistic behaviour and ultimately to satanic depravity. Shaykh-ul-Islam announced that the subsequent sessions of the lecture series would further explore the concept of ghaflah, its destructive consequences, and the Qur'anic remedies for restoring human dignity through spiritual purification, remembrance of Allah and moral transformation. The opening keynote established the intellectual and spiritual foundation of Al-Hidayah Canada 2026, presenting participants with a deeply reflective Qur'anic understanding of human nature while outlining a practical roadmap for personal reform, character development and spiritual excellence in contemporary society. Accompanying His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam were Prof Dr Hassan Mohiuddin Qadri (Chairman Supreme Council, MQI), Shaykh Hammad Mustafa al-Madani al-Qadri, Shaykh Ahmad Mustafa al-Arabi al-Qadri, Dr Faisal Iqbal Khan, Syed Shahzad Ali Faizi, Syed Saad Ali Faizi, Syed Soban Ali Faizi, Dr Ghazala Qadri (President of Minhaj-ul-Quran Women League International), and Baji Khadija Qurat-ul-Ain Qadri, each exemplifying leadership in the pursuit of authentic, scholarly Islam. #AlHidayah2026 #AlHidayahWithDrQadri #LoveOfAllah #MinhajulQuran

Beneath the waters off Dwarka, Poompuhar, and Mahabalipuram lies an archaeological archive that has barely been opened. India has over 11,000 kilometres of coastline and a maritime history spanning millennia — yet its underwater cultural heritage remains among the least governed in the world. Greece, which has been managing its submerged past for nearly five decades through specialised institutions, conservation laboratories, and underwater museums, offers one of the most relevant comparative cases for where India needs to go. A new paper by Suraj Palavalsa of the National Maritime Foundation examines what India can learn — and what a deeper India-Greece partnership in underwater cultural heritage could look like. Set in Haikou's historic district, Qilou Old Street is one of the city's best-preserved cultural landmarks. More than 600 qilou — traditional arcaded buildings with covered walkways at street level — line 12 interconnected streets, forming a vibrant streetscape that has witnessed generations of local life. In the mid-19th century, overseas Hainanese returning from Southeast Asia brought home new architectural influences, blending them with local traditions. The elegant colonnades provide shade from the tropical sun and shelter from the rain, while intricately carved windows, colorful decorative plasterwork, and local motifs give each building its distinctive character. With shops on the ground floor and living quarters above, these iconic buildings were designed to suit both daily life and the island's tropical climate. Today, wandering through the interconnected streets of Qilou Old Street offers a glimpse into Haikou's rich heritage, where history, architecture, and the neighborhood's vibrant spirit continue to flourish. #OldStreet #Haikou #Hainan #ChinaBound #ASnapshotOfChina Travel with ease in China, and with meaning. chinabound.cn

Notice all the ones about Singapore. The reason is Lee Kuan Yew. From grok: (also known as Harry Lee). He became Singapore’s first Prime Minister in 1959 and led the country after full independence in 1965. Through strict, no-nonsense governance—heavy emphasis on anti-corruption, law and order, economic pragmatism, education, and social discipline—he transformed Singapore from a poor, resource-scarce former colony into one of the world’s most prosperous and well-run city-states. Grok is being polite. He really did take a resource zero, poorly run, heavily criminal city state and turn it into one of the biggest success stories in the world. By being one of the toughest 'beneficial despots' in world history. He really did care and he saw that he had to teach the people of Singapore to be... better. More naturally law abiding, more respectful, less corrupt. And he did it by utter ruthlessness. A corrupt judge or one who let criminals walk because they were his or her ethnicity would be given a short trial and executed. (No Iryna Zarutskas) Graffiti was a fine and rodding with a cane. Lots of things were rodding with a cane. Drugs? Death penalty. Jurors of the same ethnicity letting criminals walk? Jurors would be beaten, the criminal went to jail anyway and we're eliminating jury trials. The chewing gum thing. He was walking the streets and stepped in gum. Five lashes for littering. Fifty for spitting gum on the street. (It was already five for spitting on the sidewalk.) Didn't work. Out walking, stepped in gum again. Gum is banned. Fines, jail, beatings for importation. And he did transform 'Singapore from a poor, resource-scarce former colony into one of the world’s most prosperous and well-run city-states.' But man Amnesty International hated him. До повномасштабного вторгнення бойовики терористичних проросійських угруповань контролювали приблизно 32% області. За перші 40 днів вторгнення через провал оборони на півдні України та оточення Маріуполя, кацап зумів захопити ще 22.4% Донеччини. Після цього темпи просування спали, адже Сили Оборони стали від Великої Новосілки до Вугледару, а кацап стирався у штурмах ДонУРу (Донецького укріпленого району). Історичний факт, що німецький Вермахт за неповні 47 місяців умудрився від Західного Бугу дійти до Москви та Сталінграду, а також повернутися в Берлін. Натомість "друга армія світу" за майже аналогічний період дійшла від Донецька до Покровська. Яким чином американські партнери вважають такий "черепаховий наступ" козирем — зрозуміти складно. Хоча, звісно, і ми не в змозі за нинішньої конфігурації сил звільнити всі міжнародно визнані території. В цілому, якщо великих змін не буде, то для окупації всієї Донеччини кацапам треба буде не менше 3 років. І в чому тут козир — пишіть у коментарях до публікації. Video

When Bashar, a young pharmacist and dabke dancer from Gaza, boarded a medical evacuation flight last summer, his doctors were not sure if they could save his shattered leg. A year later, I'm glad to tell you - they did. And Bashar is dancing again. After four surgeries, including a bone graft to reconstruct his tibia, his surgeon has authorized a gradual return to weight-bearing. Bashar performed a chair dance in Paris, then danced again in Bobigny, on his crutches – reconnecting with the art he loves. He has also been reunited with his father and younger brother, a source of strength on this long road to recovery, with one final surgery still ahead. My heartfelt thanks to France 🇫🇷 for receiving Bashar; the doctors and health workers in Rennes caring for him; Dr Catherine Le Scolan-Quéré for her steadfast advocacy; and the WHO colleagues and partners who helped make his evacuation possible. To date, 19 @WHO_Europe Member States have received 1,127 patients. Yet thousands of patients, including children, still urgently need treatment outside Gaza. I encourage more countries to open their doors. Quello che mi è accaduto oggi alla Camera è semplicemente allucinante. Alle 10 di questa mattina sono andato nella sede della giunta per le autorizzazioni a procedere, della quale sono membro. L'ho fatto perché avrei dovuto visionare le ormai celeberrime chat tra Delmastro e Caroccia, ovviamente nel rispetto di tutte le procedure necessarie a garanzia della riservatezza (non si possono fotografare, non si possono copiare, si viene controllati a vista dai funzionari della Camera). Il cd contenente le chat è stato inviato dalla procura di Roma al presidente della Camera, Fontana. Il quale lo ha inviato alla giunta perché lo valutasse. Quindi nel pieno rispetto del regolamento, delle mie prerogative parlamentari e delle comunicazioni ufficiali che avevo ricevuto, stamattina mi sono presentato lì per fare il mio lavoro. Io ed altri colleghi di opposizione siamo stati ricevuti da imbarazzati funzionari della Camera che ci hanno negato la consultazione delle chat. Alla mia domanda su chi li autorizzasse a negarcele, dato che il presidente della giunta era lì con noi e chiedeva anche lui di consultarle, hanno risposto che l'indicazione veniva dal Presidente della Camera. Ho chiesto se questa comunicazione gli fosse stata data in forma scritta e mi hanno risposto di no. A quel punto ho cortesemente spiegato che non mi sarei mosso da lì fino a quando non mi fosse stato consentito di visionare le chat o non avessi letto un atto del presidente Fontana che spiegava perché quel mio diritto fosse negato. Dopo due ore è arrivata una imbarazzante comunicazione di Fontana che spiegava che per sua decisione le chat erano inaccessibili. Chat che lui stesso ci aveva mandato perché le visionassimo. La motivazione formale è che ha chiesto la convocazione di una giunta per il regolamento per capire se le possiamo visionare. In quella giunta ovviamente la destra deciderà a maggioranza di non farcele vedere. Tutto questo è gravissimo e non ha alcun precedente nella storia della Camera. La presidenza in violazione di ogni regolamento e ogni prassi parlamentare, con un evidente abuso di potere, decide di cedere alle pressioni della maggioranza pur di impedire che le chat tra Delmastro e Caroccia vengano visionate dai membri della giunta. Non diffuse, non divulgate ma visionate con obbligo di riservatezza da pochi parlamentari. Decisione che è una chiara e ingiustificata violazione delle prerogative parlamentari dei componenti della giunta. Nel mentre Delmastro annuncia di averle mandate lui in procura perché non avrebbe nulla da nascondere. Peccato che la procura non le possa utilizzare senza l'autorizzazione del Parlamento. E che alla concessione dell'autorizzazione il partito di Delmastro e tutta la maggioranza si oppongono. Se Delmastro non ha nulla da nascondere, eviti queste pagliacciate e chieda alla sua maggioranza di concedere alla procura l'uso delle chat. Se la Meloni, di cui Delmastro era avvocato, davvero ha a cuore la legalità chieda alla sua maggioranza di consentire l'uso delle chat. Chat che servono per una inchiesta collegata a fatti di mafia. Anzi, che sono indispensabili per quell'inchiesta. Per quanto riguarda il presidente della Camera, oggi ha consentito la violazione dell'autonomia e della dignità dell'istituzione che presiede. Ha creato un precedente gravissimo e pericoloso. Ha messo la firma su una pagina orribile della storia repubblicana. E poi parlano di legalità.

PRESS RELEASE Family Expresses Gratitude To All Who Participated in Buhari’s Burial and Prayers The most senior member of the Buhari family, the family of the late President, Muhammadu Buhari, Malam Mamman Daura has, on behalf of the family expressed gratitude to President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and his wife, the First Lady, Senator Remi Tinubu for their role and that of Government of the Federation before, and after the passing of the former president. “It is truly comforting to receive such support from the President and the Vice President, Kashim Shettima, who went to the United Kingdom, and here in Daura, for the days he and the ministers during the mourning period. These have instilled confidence in all of us to face this loss with courage. “We are deeply grateful to the President on his thoughtful gestures in declaring a public holiday and renaming the University of Maiduguri after Buhari. “Our gratitude also goes to leaders of the various countries around the globe who either came in person, sent representatives, sent letters, or placed personal telephone calls to commiserate with us. Of special note were those of the King of England, King Charles III, the Secretary General of the United Nations, the Deputy Secretary General, Amina Mohammed, the Chairman of the African Union, and that of the Committee of Heads of State and Government of ECOWAS countries, and our former Head of State, Abdulsalami Abubakar. “Muhammadu Buhari’s demise is an irreparable loss and its pain is beyond words, but the general reaction and kind expressions give us the strength to cope with the loss of our esteemed family member and former leader of the country. “The family is equally grateful to Vice President Kashim Shettima in his own person and his wife, and to all state governors, especially those of Katsina, the host governor Dr Dikko Umar Radda; Professor Babagana Umara Zulum of Borno State and all those who visited us in the UK and Daura from Adamawa, Kano, Kwara, Lagos, Kaduna, Imo, Nasarawa, Bauchi, Sokoto, Kebbi as well as the several former governors, including Dr Peter Obi for their compassionate words of condolence. Your empathy has touched our hearts deeply, and we are truly grateful for your kindness. "We express our deep appreciations to former Vice Presidents Atiku Abubakar, Architect Namadi Sambo, Professor Yemi Osinbajo, and Ambassador Babagana Kingibe as well as to the President of Senate, Godswill Akpabio, the Speaker, House of Representatives, Honorable Tajuddeen Abbas, Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin and the other leaders and members of the National and State Assemblies. “We do sincerely thank the Secretary to the Government of the Federation, SGF, Senator George Akume and his predecessor in office, Boss Mustapha, the current Chief of Staff, Honorable Femi Gbajabiamila and his predecessor, Professor Ibrahim Gambari, former and serving members of the cabinet in both administrations for their activities in these events and their comforting words. “We are very pleased with the amazing gestures of our traditional leaders, notably the Sultan of Sokoto, the Shehu of Borno, the Emir of Gwandu and the host emirs of Katsina and Daura, as well as the various emirs and chiefs from all over Nigeria and the neighboring countries who came in person or sent representatives. “We have been honored by the large turnout of religious leaders, Islamic, Christian and of other faiths, community leaders, women, youth and politicians of various leanings whose surge in Daura was both challenging and reassuring. “The family in Daura is also thanking past and serving security and intelligence, police and military leaders, permanent secretaries, and the rank and file civil servants, community groups and associations, civil society, and the media of communications. 1/2

This is not AI. Brilliantly captured by Chandrasekar Das, this stunning leopard resting somewhere in Nilgiris, reminds me about an interesting fact that often goes unnoticed. While most people know India counts its tigers every four years through the All India Tiger Estimation (AITE), not many know that the same nationwide survey by @ntca_india also produces one of the world’s most rigorous leopard population estimates. Individual leopards are identified by their unique rosette patterns, just as tigers are recognised by their stripe patterns, The latest Status of Leopards in India, 2022 estimated 13,874 leopards (95% CI: 12,616–15,132) across India’s tiger-bearing landscapes, which encompass nearly 70% of the country’s leopard habitat. Every tiger photographed, therefore, also tells the story of leopards, prey, habitats and the health of an entire forest ecosystem. Amazing 😊 #leopards #wildlife #TNForest

This is one of the most beloved paintings in America, and it puts its finger on something we all pass through, first as the child, and one day as the parent left behind... The painting is Breaking Home Ties, by Norman Rockwell, on the cover of the Saturday Evening Post in 1954. A father and his teenage son sit side by side on the running board of a battered farm truck, waiting at a railway stop. A single track runs along the bottom of the picture. A ticket pokes from the boy's pocket. His suitcase is stacked with schoolbooks and wears a "State U" pennant. The train is coming to carry him off to college, away from home, for the first time in his life. Everything is in the way they sit. The son sits upright, scrubbed and dressed in his best, eyes fixed on the horizon, on the track, on the future rushing toward him. He is already half gone. For him that train is the beginning of everything. His father sits beside him in worn work clothes and scuffed boots, looking the other way, down the line, as if he cannot bear to watch it arrive. The same train means the opposite thing to him. For the son it is the start of a life. For the father it is the day the house grows quieter, the chair at the table sits empty, and the person he built his world around walks out into a life that no longer has him at its centre. Look at his hands. He is holding two hats. His own battered one, and resting on top of it, his son's crisp new one, held carefully together, because it is the last small thing he can still do for the boy... And then the dog, its head laid in the son's lap, gazing up, refusing to look away. Rockwell knew exactly what that was for: "The father couldn't show how he felt about the boy's leaving," he said. "The dog did." It has moved people for 70 years because every leaving is a beginning for one person and an ending for another. The child steps out into the world, as they should. And someone stays behind, watching them go, and loving them enough to let them go anyway...

राष्ट्रसेवा आणि राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षेतील अतुलनीय योगदानाचा सन्मान! केंद्रीय गृह व सहकार मंत्री अमित शाह यांच्या हस्ते आणि मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या प्रमुख उपस्थितीत भारताचे राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा सल्लागार अजित डोवाल यांना 'लोकमान्य टिळक राष्ट्रीय पुरस्कार 2026' प्रदान करण्यात आला. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यावेळी म्हणाले, आज सर्वांकरिता अतिशय आनंदाचा दिवस आहे. देशातील अनेक मान्यवरांचा लोकमान्य टिळक राष्ट्रीय पुरस्काराने गौरव करण्यात आला आहे. यंदा हा पुरस्कार राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षेला नवी दिशा देणाऱ्या आणि त्यासाठी आपले जीवन समर्पित करणाऱ्या अजित डोवाल यांना प्रदान करण्यात आला आहे. राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षेच्या क्षेत्रात ज्यांना 'चाणक्य' म्हणून ओळखले जाते, त्या अजित डोवाल यांना हा पुरस्कार प्रदान करण्यासाठी राजकीय क्षेत्रातील 'चाणक्य' येथे उपस्थित आहेत. अजित डोवाल यांनी प्रथम पोलीस सेवेत, त्यानंतर इंटेलिजन्स ब्युरो (आयबी) आणि रिसर्च अँड ॲनालिसिस विंगच्या (R&AW) माध्यमातून देशासाठी अत्यंत महत्त्वपूर्ण कार्य केले. विशेषतः 2014 मध्ये पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांनी अजित डोवाल यांची राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा सल्लागार म्हणून नियुक्ती केल्यानंतर त्यांनी देशाच्या सुरक्षा व्यवस्थेत आमूलाग्र बदल घडवून आणण्याचे काम केले. अजित डोवाल यांनी राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षेसाठी आखलेल्या रणनीतीमुळे भारत आता शत्रूच्या भूमीत घुसून प्रत्युत्तर देणारा देश बनला आहे. अजित डोवाल यांनी अनेकदा स्वतःचा जीव धोक्यात घालून देशासाठी कार्य केले, मात्र त्यासाठी कधीही कोणत्याही पुरस्काराची अपेक्षा ठेवली नाही. अशा व्यक्तिमत्त्वाला लोकमान्य टिळक राष्ट्रीय पुरस्कार प्रदान होत असल्याचा अत्यंत आनंद आहे, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले, भारतात राष्ट्रवादाची मुहूर्तमेढ रोवण्याचे कार्य समाजसुधारक आणि थोर क्रांतिकारक लोकमान्य बाळ गंगाधर टिळक यांनी केले. त्यामुळे त्यांना भारतीय राष्ट्रवादाचे जनक म्हटले जाते. भारत ब्रिटिशांच्या गुलामीत असताना लोकमान्य टिळक यांनी भारतीयांची मानसिकता बदलून त्यांच्या मनामध्ये देशभक्तीची भावना जागवली. आपला समाज धार्मिक व आध्यात्मिक असल्याने समाजाला एकत्र आणण्यासाठी त्यांनी सार्वजनिक गणेशोत्सवाची सुरुवात केली. बहुजन समाजाला एकत्रित करून स्वातंत्र्यलढ्याला व्यापक लोकचळवळीचे स्वरूप दिले. तसेच सार्वजनिक शिवजयंती उत्सवाच्या माध्यमातून तरुणांना राष्ट्रभक्ती आणि स्वाभिमानाची प्रेरणा दिली. अशाच समर्पणाने आणि देशभक्तीच्या भावनेने आयुष्यभर राष्ट्रसेवा करणाऱ्या अजित डोवाल यांना हा पुरस्कार प्रदान करण्यात येत असल्याचा आनंद आहे. यावेळी उपमुख्यमंत्री एकनाथ शिंदे, उपमुख्यमंत्री सुनेत्रा अजित पवार, केंद्रीय राज्यमंत्री मुरलीधर मोहोळ, मंत्री चंद्रकांत पाटील, मंत्री उदय सामंत, राज्यमंत्री माधुरी मिसाळ, आमदार रविंद्र चव्हाण, लोकमान्य टिळक स्मारक ट्रस्टचे अध्यक्ष डॉ. रोहित टिळक व इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @narendramodi Today we celebrate George de Hevesy’s birthday! He was a radiochemist who helped develop radioactive tracers. Born in 1885, de Hevesy first stumbled on radiotracers while trying to perform another experiment (that proved to be impossible) involving radium-D, or lead-210. A radiotracer is made by replacing one or more atoms of a chemical compound with a radioactive isotope of the same chemical element. Then by using a sensitive radiation detection device, scientists can track the small amount of radiation released from the radioactive isotope. In this case, de Hevesy figured out he could introduce a small sample of lead-212, a radioactive isotope of lead, into the roots of a plant and then by monitoring how it moved through a plant, he could understand the plant’s metabolic processes. This work on radiotracers earned de Hevesy the 1943 @NobelPrize for Chemistry. Radiotracers are still an effective tool used today in a range of areas, from medicine to industry to environmental science.

What kinds of investment enable small-scale producers to move into higher-value markets, stronger processing capacity and better returns from their production? In Nepal, the US$18.9 million High Value Agriculture Project in Hill and Mountain Areas (HVAP) – co-financed by IFAD, the Government of Nepal, the SNV Netherlands Development Organization and other partners – offers a strong example. The project supported small-scale producers with improved processing methods, technical assistance and stronger market linkages, helping create the conditions for more reliable buyers and private-sector engagement. A Nepali-Dutch joint venture, the Organic Valley, expanded a local processing plant and by 2026 was sourcing ginger from more than 1,400 farmers and exporting 347 metric tons to Europe. Over time, production increased from 300 metric tonnes to 2,400, farmers’ incomes rose by 37%, and crop earnings increased by 50%. As HVAP shows, sustainable rural economic growth is driven not only by increased production, but by the private sector linkages that connect producers to global markets across strong value chains. از دوران مجاهدان و دور قبلی طالبان که بگذریم، این روزها شاید تاریک‌ترین روزهایی باشد که پوهنتون کابل با آن روبه‌رو است. پوهنتون کابل در سال ۱۳۱۱ خورشیدی تأسیس شد. در آغاز، فقط دانشکده‌ی طب در آن بود. بعدها، پس از تشکیل دانشکده‌های حقوق، ساینس و ادبیات، رسما به نام پوهنتون کابل مسمی شد. این پوهنتون که نزدیک به یک قرن از زمان تأسیس آن می‌گذرد، شاگردان زیادی از آن فارغ شده‌اند. افرادی همچون داکتر محمد یوسف، سلطان‌علی کشتمند، اناهیتا راتب‌زاد، طاهر بدخشی، سیما سمر، عبدالغفور روان‌ فرهادی، حمیده برمکی، اکرم یاری، واصف باختری... شاگردان نامدار این پوهنتون بودند. اما امروزه، پوهنتون کابل در وضعی است که سزاوارش نیست. امروز، نه ما شاگردان خیلی زبده هستیم و نه پوهنتون کابل آن پوهنتونی است که بود و یا باید باشد. شواهد تاریخی نشان می‌دهد که پوهنتون کابل اکثرا مکانی برای مبارزه با افراطیت، بی‌عدالتی، فساد، خرافات و... بوده است؛ اما امروز خبری از آن مبارزه‌ها نیست. در بیست سال جمهوریت کرزی و غنی، همچنان پوهنتون کابل جایگاه ویژه‌ی خود را داشت. شاگردان انقلابی داشت؛ شاگردانی که به تشدید خرافات «نه» می‌گفتند. در آن دوران، شاهد اعتراضاتی بودیم که در آن همواره از سران انتقاد می‌شد. شاهد تظاهرات برای مبارزه با فساد، بیکاری و غیره بودیم. در این ۲۰ سال نیز شاگردان خیلی به‌دردبخوری از این پوهنتون فارغ شدند. برعکس روزهایی که در پوهنتون کابل با افراطیت مبارزه می‌شد، امروز همان افراطیت در آن حاکم شده است. ملاها هر قسم که دل‌شان شود، فرمان می‌دهند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258326

For China’s wealth owners, four measures matter most: • The Supervision Law (2018; revised 2024) — transformed the risk to personal liberty. • The Counter-Espionage Law (2023) — vastly expanded the boundaries of “national security.” • The new offshore trust tax rules (July 2026) — fundamentally changed the calculation of wealth protection. • The new Exit-Entry Regulations (August 2026) — strengthened the state’s control over mobility and the ability to leave. For decades, the typical Chinese tycoon believed he could continue living in China, keep his business and political relationships there, leave part of his family there, but place his shares, cash and investments in Hong Kong, the Cayman Islands, BVI or an offshore trust, obtain foreign residency or even a second passport, and thereby continue enjoying China’s economic upside while placing his core wealth beyond the Party’s reach. That assumption has collapsed. Almost every entrepreneur I have known over the past three decades underestimated the ruthlessness of the CCP. Ironically, those who understood the risks best were often the red aristocrats. They had witnessed the Party’s campaigns, purges and expropriations from the inside. Many private entrepreneurs, by contrast, had studied too little of modern Chinese history. One phrase I heard many times was: “All my wealth came from China. If one day the government wants it back, I am happy to give it back.” This was not merely public relations language used by people such as Jack Ma of Alibaba or Richard Liu of JD. Entrepreneurs often said it directly to my face when I urged them to diversify their wealth outside China. I suspect many never truly believed that day might actually come. For most wealth owners, it is probably too late now. If the individual remains in China, the state holds the decisive leverage: exit bans, investigation, summons, detention, tax enforcement, and pressure applied through trustees, banks or family members. An offshore trust may protect assets in an ordinary civil dispute. It cannot reliably protect a settlor who remains physically inside an authoritarian state. If the wealth still originates from Chinese companies, dividends, red-chip structures, property sales or family transfers, the authorities can pursue it through tax residency, foreign exchange rules, beneficial ownership and source-of-funds investigations. A foreign passport, by itself, does not end Chinese tax exposure. What matters is where you actually live, where your family is, where your economic interests remain, and whether China still regards you as a tax resident. If your spouse, children, parents, beneficiaries or family business remain in China, the state still retains substantial leverage. I am convinced Beijing thought carefully about the sequence before introducing these measures. The offshore trust rules and the new Exit-Entry Regulations were not introduced because the leadership feared wealthy Chinese might start running. They were introduced because Beijing believes the window for most of them to escape has already closed. For decades, many Chinese entrepreneurs misunderstood the true nature of the CCP. The boom years convinced them that the Party itself may have fundamentally changed—that the political risks of the Mao era belonged to history. At the same time, the extraordinary opportunities created by China’s economic boom made the upside of staying fully invested in China seem far greater than the cost of preparing for a much darker future. Xi Jinping did not fundamentally change the nature of the CCP. He just reminded China’s entrepreneurs what it had always been capable of. For many, the risks they dismissed have become reality. Perhaps foreign investors should pay close attention to the lesson being taught—at the expense of China’s entrepreneurs.

This is the conventional wisdom: Microsoft should make security features free or include them in lower-tier plans. Unfortunately, in this specific example from @HackingLZ, moving risk-based Conditional Access to P1 is unlikely to make a significant dent in global security risk. Why? I spent the better part of three years trying to persuade organizations that already had E5 licenses to enable P2 features. Sadly, very few did. Even though they were already paying for them. Deployment simply required too much work and change management on their end. My entire team at Microsoft worked with E5 customers, and one of the things we actively tracked and followed up on was the deployment of risk-based Conditional Access policies. Microsoft even offered incentives to account teams worldwide when the customers they managed enabled risk-based Conditional Access. Yet there were still very few takers. So, taking a step back: what can Microsoft do to have the greatest impact on the security of all its customers? My observation was that the biggest improvements came from security features that required customers to do nothing. The “Microsoft-managed” class of features is what actually moves the needle on security. Some key initiatives included: → Blocking legacy authentication protocols for Exchange Online → Enforcing MFA for Azure (you wouldn’t believe how many enterprises. Even regulated ones, threw the book at us over this) → Introducing Microsoft-managed Conditional Access policies → Blocking device code flow by default The next major effort is disabling SMS and voice-based MFA while rolling out passkeys. That change alone will improve security for an enormous number of organizations. These initiatives require a huge amount of time, effort, and follow-up to help customers manage the impact. Many of the ones listed above were multi-year projects, with some taking three+ years to move the final group of customers across. In my opinion, it can sometimes be better for more advanced features to remain paid. Customers recognize them as premium capabilities, pay for them, and 'ideally' commit the resources needed to deploy them properly. Featured speakers included Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao (pictured below), Vice Chief of Naval Operations Adm. James Kilby, Assistant Secretary of War (Science and Technology) Dr. Joseph Jewell, futurist Dr. Peter Singer and Chief of Naval Research Dr. Rachel Riley. They were joined by Sailors and Marines, researchers, industry, academia and innovators whose partnerships continue to advance naval science and technology. Through keynote remarks and technology exhibits, the event underscored a fundamental truth: maintaining our technological edge requires investing in ideas long before they become operational capabilities. As outlined in ONR's newly released Science & Technology Strategy, the DoN’s most consequential challenges demand research that is transformational, uniquely Naval and often too early or specialized for others to attempt. ONR exists to discover, develop and deliver the S&T that underpins those capabilities, ensuring the Fleet and Force remain ready to meet tomorrow's challenges. “For eight decades, ONR has stood at the vanguard of naval power,” Cao said. “You’re the operational engine that transforms science fiction into tactical reality on the high seas.” Since 1946, ONR has brought together the people and partnerships needed to pursue the scientific research and technological development required to sustain America's maritime dominance.
